cards.caption: Ben Shelton has added Juan Carlos Ferrero to his 2027 staff, and searches for the news are climbing. His father Bryan has drawn special credit for being open to the hire.
A new Axios analysis says 75% of Americans could have a Democratic governor following the midterm results. The figure reflects how the governor races across the country have turned out.
Victor Wembanyama posted 52 points, 24 rebounds and 8 blocks in a Spurs win, a first in NBA history. The performance has fans talking about one of the league's biggest young stars.
Bournemouth travel to Sparta Prague looking for a fourth straight Europa League win, and one fan says the trip feels like a pinch me moment.
Juventus meet AZ Alkmaar in the Europa League, and US fans are searching heavily for how to watch the match live. Lineups and streaming details are the main draw ahead of kickoff.
California Gov. Gavin Newsom has commuted the sentences of all 548 death row inmates in the state. The move is a major shift in how the state handles capital punishment.
NieR:Automata's latest Steam update jumps the game's install size from 50GB to 366GB. Patch notes for the update are now out.
South Korean chip stocks fell sharply in pre-market trading as fears about AI spread after a US sell-off. The benchmark KOSPI index dropped below 5,000.
Gothamist reports six people were killed and nine injured in a fire in Brooklyn's Sunset Park. Officials are the source for the toll.
Sylvester Stallone reflects on a long, contentious feud with Arnold Schwarzenegger and what finally ended it. The trending search shows Americans are curious about the rivalry.

Draymond Green has responded to Dillon Brooks after their altercation in the Warriors-Suns game, and Kendrick Perkins has added his own take. The back-and-forth is drawing attention across NBA social feeds.
Democrats have flipped more than 40 House seats in the 2026 midterms, according to CBS News live coverage. Republicans are grappling with the stunning losses.
A police agent was killed and three officers were shot in a shooting on an RTD bus, with one civilian also injured, according to CBS News. Details are still emerging.
US authorities say a Mexican judge was arrested by the FBI and accused of taking bribes in an international drug trafficking case. The case is reportedly linked to a former Olympian.
Rep. Jim Clyburn has won an 18th term in the U.S. House, according to reports. Midlands races are still being tallied.

Three people have been charged over an alleged scheme that used AI to impersonate chief executives and attorneys in an effort to steal $129 million. It is a reminder that a familiar voice on the phone is no longer proof of who is calling.
Thomas Markle, Meghan's father, has been arrested on charges related to child sexual abuse material, according to AP sources. The allegations are unproven at this stage.
Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson says he was hospitalized after an unusual emergency and is focused on recovery. He is among the most searched names in the US this hour.
Nithya Raman has won the Los Angeles mayor's race over incumbent Karen Bass, according to BBC reporting. The result is part of a wider Democratic midterm sweep.
Warriors center Kristaps Porzingis is reportedly stepping away from the team to prioritize his health. Fans are searching for him in large numbers as the news spreads.
Searches for the Sixers vs Cavaliers game are topping US trends as LeBron James returns for his homecoming. Full injury reports are out ahead of Friday's tip-off.
Hornets forward Brandon Miller left an NBA Cup game against the Celtics with an injury, and fans are searching for an update. Details on his condition were not in the headlines reviewed.

Florida voters nearly tripled the homeowner tax break, which Fortune reports leaves an $11.8 billion hole in county budgets. The shortfall could reach the local services and schools residents rely on.
Luka Dončić is being hailed as the Lakers' pilot after a historic stretch, and fans are searching for every detail. Here is what the buzz is about.

A trending tennis moment: an emergency alarm stopped Bianca Andreescu's match in Cali while she was serving for victory, and the venue was evacuated. Searches for the story are climbing as fans look for what happened next.
Fortune reports the Iran war has cost $38 billion and 19 U.S. lives, with Vance quoted on why the outcome was lost. The figures are as the outlet reported them.
Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku, the streaming platform many Americans use to watch TV. The deal changes who owns one of the biggest players in home streaming.
Carson Daly is set to co-host the new Saturday TODAY alongside Laura Jarrett while keeping his weekday role. He has shared how he is feeling about the move.
